title: Привычки, которые изменились
description: Сравниваем прошлый и нынешний образ жизни с used to и Past Simple.
objectives: Описать прежнее состояние с used to
notes: Used to описывает привычку или состояние, которые теперь изменились.
После didn't пишем use to без -d.

exercises.prompt: Как описать прежнюю привычку, которой больше нет?

options.label: I use cycling to work last year.
I used to cycle to work, but now I take the bus.

exercises.editorial_answer: I used to cycle to work, but now I take the bus.
exercises.explanation: Used to и but now явно сопоставляют прошлое и настоящее.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение подходящим словом или краткой формой.

public_payload.sentence: I didn't ___ to enjoy cooking, but now I do.

exercises.prompt: Собери вопрос о прежнем месте жительства.
exercises.editorial_answer: Did you use to live near the sea?
exercises.explanation: После did глагольная часть use to без -d.

public_payload.sentence: She didn't used to wear glasses.

accepted: She didn't use to wear glasses.

exercises.reference_answer: She didn't use to wear glasses.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She didn't used to wear glasses.
exercises.editorial_answer: She didn't use to wear glasses.

accepted: There used to be a factory here.
A factory used to stand here.

exercises.reference_answer: There used to be a factory here.
exercises.incorrect_answer: There will be a factory here.
exercises.editorial_answer: There used to be a factory here.
exercises.explanation: Used to be/stand описывает прежнее состояние, не будущее.

options.label: His usual way of getting to work.
His interest in cycling disappeared completely.
He stopped leaving the city at weekends.

public_payload.passage: When Oliver lived in a village, he used to cycle to work along a quiet road. After moving to the city, he tried cycling once, but the heavy traffic made him uncomfortable. He now takes the underground during the week. He still enjoys cycling at weekends, when he can choose quieter routes outside the centre.

exercises.editorial_answer: His usual way of getting to work.
exercises.explanation: Он сменил способ поездки на работу, но продолжает кататься в выходные.

options.label: I am shy tomorrow because yesterday.
I used to be shy, but joining the drama club helped.
I used to confident every weekend.

lines.speaker: Former classmate
lines.text: You seem much more confident now.

exercises.editorial_answer: I used to be shy, but joining the drama club helped.
exercises.explanation: Used to be shy описывает изменившееся состояние.

exercises.prompt: Выбери связку для сравнения прошлого и настоящего.

public_payload.sentence: I used to buy printed newspapers, ___ now I read the news online.
